highlights.title: Global momentum
highlights.detail: World CO₂ was 37123.9 Mt in 2021, 1859.8 Mt above 2020.

highlights.title: Top emitter
highlights.detail: World contributes 1736930 Mt across the record, leading global totals.

insights.narrative: The CO₂ dataset spans 1750-2021, tracing the rise of fossil emissions from industrialized economies while global totals climbed into the tens of gigatonnes.
actions: Scale zero-carbon grids to displace coal and gas baseload.
Cut oil demand with transit, EV freight, and active mobility.
Rebuild materials loops with circular steel, cement, and recycling.
questions: Which regions bent their emissions curves after policy shifts?
How fast can top emitters close the gap to net-zero trajectories?
Where do per-capita trends diverge from economic growth?
